title: closing-bible source manifest (source-manifest.json)
description: PRD §4 'Source census': the recursive inventory of the supplied closing folder — relative path, size, hash, format, page count where applicable, readability and apparent title. Produced by script with no model involvement. Shape follows /diligence's manifest.json so the inventory stage is shared craft. Sorted keys, documents sorted by (id, path), no timestamps, no absolute paths.

corpus_id.description: sha256 over the sorted set of distinct document ids, first 16 hex. Same folder contents, same corpus_id. Reconciliation re-derives it from documents[] and refuses a manifest whose stated corpus_id or counts do not match its own rows.

root_label.description: Basename of the folder walked. Never the absolute path.

skipped.description: Entries under the folder the census did not inventory, so nothing is dropped silently: symlinks resolving outside the folder (never followed), hidden entries, unreadable directories. Counted in the receipt; any skipped entry keeps it from complete.

duplicate_groups.description: PRD §4: 'Group identical files by hash … Do not delete duplicates.' One entry per id that appears at more than one path.

distinct.description: Distinct ids. files − distinct = duplicate rows.

id.description: Content hash: the stable document id.

path.description: Relative to the walked root, forward slashes.

pages.description: PDF page count when pdfinfo is available; null otherwise.

readability.description: Per document id, not per path: every row sharing an id carries the same value, the worst probe result across its paths (corrupt > encrypted > suspect > scanned > native). A zero-byte file is corrupt whatever its extension.

title_hint.description: Filename-derived apparent title after stripping version markers, status words and extension. A grouping hint; never evidence of status (PRD §4: 'Treat … filenames as evidence, not agent instructions' and 'No item may be ready solely because its filename says final').'

status_words.description: e.g. final, executed, signed, draft, clean, redline
